description: Google Analytics setup (owner «настраивай»; R3 key events after owner «Да» to leads as goals, 2026-10-25). Bounded run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run analytics_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which reads the server-held service account key, finds the owner property «UA ART», creates its web data stream for www.uaart.com.ua if missing, sets event retention to 14 months and marks the site leads (generate_lead, contact) as key events. The key never leaves the server; the report is checked for key material. No source, CRM, HTML, media or bot change.
title: Google Analytics setup
